criteria.description: Correctly recalls MATH and DYN's core ideas.

solutions.fullSolution: MATH: Taylor expansion, gradients/Jacobians/Hessians, matrix calculus, dual spaces/metrics, SVD/eigendecomposition, and the covariant gradient. DYN: equations of motion, PID, inverse dynamics, LQR/Bellman, splines, controllability/Lyapunov stability, MPC. SYM: propositional/first-order logic, unification, STRIPS/PDDL, probabilistic relational rules, MLNs.

criteria.description: Correctly places (a) at the known-model end and (b) toward model-free.
Correctly identifies (a) needs less real data but risks the sim-to-real gap.

solutions.fullSolution: (a) sits at the fully-known-model end (LQR), zero real-world data needed but limited by simulator accuracy. (b) sits toward model-free, using real data to correct simulator error, closer to RLEARN-01/RL-03. (a) needs less real data by construction but risks poor real-world performance from the sim-to-real gap; (b) needs more data but directly corrects for it -- exactly why hybrid approaches like RLEARN-01's residual learning and RLEARN-04's domain randomization exist.
